title: Artifact instance (a produced material on the laboratory shelf)
description: ADR-0007 'artifact instances as first-class addressable objects'. A labelled jar on the shelf: ONE concrete material produced by a Tool run or pipeline step, made addressable. Where tool_run/pipeline_run records reflect the EVENT, an artifact_instance reflects the MATERIAL — typed by its glossary term (the port type-system), bound to its producer, and pointing at an on-disk blob. The 'recognised materials only' rule (Girish, 2026-06-07): an output is reified IFF the Tool's ports.output names it; nameless scratch returns stay in-memory. The card is closure-counted; the blob it points at (artifact_instances/data/<id>) is gitignored like a figure. Addressable so a later run can re-feed it ($artifact.<id>) instead of recomputing — the working-pantry payoff.

id.description: Artifact-instance id: 'ai_' + the producing run's slug (its tr_/pr_ prefix stripped) + '_' + a per-run sequence number, lowercase underscore. Unique because the producing run id is unique; the sequence disambiguates multiple materials from one run. Stable forever; may be re-fed by a later run as $artifact.<id>.

artifact_type.description: The TYPE of material, written as a glossary_term id (the glossary doubles as the port type-system). Referential: must resolve to a glossary_term. This is the value the producing Tool's ports.output mapped this return-key to.

cardinality.description: 'one' = a single material from a compose step (one-epoch / single object). 'set' = a collection from a map step lifted over a window (ADR-0007 §2: 'a cloud for the whole LC is the same Tool mapped over a window -> a set of IA Clouds').

produced_by.description: Lineage: which run made this material, and (for a pipeline) which step.

run.description: The producing run id. Referential: must resolve to a tool_run (tr_...) or a pipeline_run (pr_...).

step.description: The pipeline step id that produced this (matches a pipeline.steps[].id). Null for a bare tool_run (no DAG).

port.description: Which output port produced this material — the return-dict key, the tuple-position name, or the single-return label, exactly as named in the Tool's ports.output map. The provenance of WHICH value this is.

path.description: Path to the material. For storage='blob' (default): repo-relative path to the gitignored on-disk blob reify wrote (artifact_instances/data/<id>.npz for arrays, .json for scalars/structured). For storage='reference': the path REFERENCES a file the producing Tool wrote in its own location (e.g. a SPICE kernel) — no copy; repo-relative when under the repo, else absolute. Either way this card is the addressable, committed handle.

storage.description: How the material is held (ADR-0007 Slice 1.5b). 'blob' (default, may be omitted): reify wrote a gitignored copy under artifact_instances/data/. 'reference': the material is a FILE the producing Tool wrote in its own location (a SPICE kernel, etc.); the card references it directly, no blob copy. load() returns the file PATH for a reference (you furnsh a kernel, you don't parse it into memory) and the in-memory value for a blob.

cardinality_n.description: For cardinality='set', how many elements the set holds (the map fan-out width). Null for 'one'.

size_bytes.description: On-disk size of the blob (for the dashboard; never the blob itself in the store).

sample.description: A small digest of the material for the dashboard (shape/dtype for arrays, keys for dicts, value for scalars). NEVER the full blob.

caption.description: One-line human label for the shelf, e.g. 'IA Cloud . from sample step'.

commit.description: git SHA the producing run executed at (reproducibility).
